legacyProblems.note: Geometry counts indicate features containing invalid components, not that every component in those features is invalid. Region-majority ownership and missing subdivisions are separate historical defects.

OpenHistoricalMap.note: Discovery and geometry audit moved into the 1830 Scenario Source Pack, which adds seven supplemental relations and resolves all six failures.

Cliopatria.role: Reviewed historical supplements, not automatic gap filling

NaturalEarth.role: Physical coastline/hydrography and settlement coordinates, not evidence for 1830 sovereignty

requiredBeforePromotion: Curate the exact-date polity roster, including dependencies, disputed authority and all small states. Discovery output is not approval.
Resolve each of the six malformed national source geometries using documented endpoint corrections or hash-pinned historical supplements.
Complete source-backed province subdivisions. Existing OHM coverage includes Scotland, Wales and Ireland but is incomplete for English counties; record and resolve coverage gaps explicitly.
Assign persistent province keys and retain an append-only runtime ID registry. Produce explicit save migration/version handling; never renumber by sorting names.
Compile one shared-edge topology with holes and enclaves. Derive adjacency, national borders, fills and picking from it; simplify shared arcs once at each level of detail.
Validate exclusive overlaps, missing land coverage against a pinned physical coastline, province ownership and roster coverage. Require all geographic-contract assertions.
Build tiled levels of detail and fingerprints for 2D/3D from the same compiled geography. A 4096-pixel global province mask must not define close-zoom border precision.
Review regional visual baselines for Britain, Canada, the German states and northern Italy in political/terrain/2D modes before replacing the runtime atlas.
